transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good morning, thank you for calling S-Net Mobile Support. My name is Megan. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Megan, I'm Anusha. My voicemail box locked itself after I typed the wrong four-digit passcode three times, and I'm waiting for an urgent hospital cardiology clinic message.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh Anusha, I am so sorry you are dealing with that! I completely understand how stressful being locked out is.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, Megan. The hospital switchboard rang at 8:45 AM while I was in the shower.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay Anusha, so your voicemail box locked itself after you typed the wrong four-digit passcode three times, and you're waiting for an urgent hospital cardiology clinic message.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, when I dial 121 now, an automated voice says my mailbox access is suspended.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please don't worry, Anusha—a voicemail passcode lockout never deletes any unread messages sitting in your inbox.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh thank goodness! I was terrified resetting the code would wipe out the doctor's recording.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It is completely safe. Clearing the security lockout only resets your four-digit voicemail passcode.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is such a relief to hear. Can we unlock the mailbox right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, we can unlock it right on this call. Let me ask a few quick diagnostic questions first.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, go right ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What make and model of mobile handset are you using today, Anusha?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am using a Samsung Galaxy S23.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are you currently dialling 121 over the mobile network signal or over Wi-Fi Calling?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Both 5G mobile signal and Wi-Fi Calling are switched on right now at home.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does the suspension voice prompt disconnect the call immediately after reading the message?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it reads out the suspension notice twice and disconnects the call automatically.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you swapped your physical SIM card or moved to an eSIM recently?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I have had this same S-Net physical SIM card for over a year.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When did you last update your four-digit voicemail passcode?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: About a month ago, and I mixed up the last two digits.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is the tape-reel voicemail icon showing at the top of your Samsung Galaxy S23?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the tape-reel icon popped up at 8:46 AM and is still there.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, that confirms the hospital recording is sitting safely in your inbox.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wonderful, how do we reset the voicemail passcode now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before I reset the mailbox on the switch, can you confirm your home address and account PIN for security?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my home address is 62 Clarendon Park Road, Leicester, LE2 3AD, and my account PIN is 8426.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Anusha, and could you also confirm the answer to your security question, which is the name of your first primary school?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is Stoneygate Primary School.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you very much, that is all verified. I have opened your mobile profile on our IMS Voicemail Server, and it shows `LOCK_STATUS: HARD_LOCK_3_STRIKES` logged at 08:49 AM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 8:49 AM was right when I made the third attempt! Can you see how many unread messages are stored inside the mailbox?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes! I can see `UNREAD_VOICE_MESSAGES: 1`, recorded today at 08:46:12 AM, with an audio length of 48 seconds—and your three saved messages are untouched too.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Forty-eight seconds—that will have all the appointment details from the cardiology coordinator. How do we unlock it without touching that recording?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am going to execute a `VM_AUTH_CLEAR` command on our mobile voice switch, which clears the three-strike lockout flag and assigns a temporary four-digit passcode of `1999`.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, and once I dial 121 and enter `1999`, will it let me play the 48-second hospital message straight away?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: As soon as you key in `1999`, the automated tutorial will ask you to enter a new four-digit voicemail passcode of your choice followed by hash, and then it will play your unread message immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That sounds very straightforward. Let's do that right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please bear with me for just over a minute while I execute the security token reset on the IMS voicemail switch and resynchronise your SIM profile, Anusha.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you so much for holding, Anusha. The `HARD_LOCK_3_STRIKES` flag has now been cleared on the switch, and your temporary voicemail passcode is active as `1999`.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, Megan! Should I try dialling 121 on speakerphone right now while I have you on the line to make sure it works?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes please, Anusha! Because your Samsung Galaxy S23 supports VoLTE multi-call hold, you can put our call on speaker and tap 'Add Call' to dial 121 right now while I stay on the line.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I am tapping 'Add Call' on my Samsung screen and dialling 121 now... it is ringing the voicemail platform.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take your time, Anusha, I am staying right here on the line until you have listened to the hospital message and written everything down.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is asking me for my temporary passcode now... I am typing `1999` followed by the hash key... oh brilliant, it accepted it and is asking me to choose a new four-digit code!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic! Key in a memorable four-digit number that isn't four identical digits like `1111` or sequential like `1234`, and then press the hash key.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I just entered my new four-digit code and pressed hash... it asked me to repeat it to confirm... and now it says my new code is saved!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful! Has it started reading out the timestamp of the new message from 8:46 AM?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it says 'First unread message, received today at 8:46 AM'... hold on while I listen to the audio recording.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go right ahead, there is no rush at all—make sure you get the doctor's name, clinic room, and phone extension.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Listening now... okay, it is Dr Patel's cardiology secretary at Glenfield Hospital offering me a cancellation slot for my echocardiogram tomorrow morning at 10:30 AM in Clinic B!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh Anusha, I am so glad we got you into that voicemail box in time so you didn't miss out on a cancellation slot for tomorrow morning!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: She said I need to ring extension 4419 before 12:00 noon today to confirm I'm taking the 10:30 AM slot, so getting this unlocked right now has genuinely saved my appointment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did you want to replay the message once more to double-check the extension number, or press 2 on your keypad to archive it in your saved folder?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I just pressed 2 on the keypad and the voice confirmed the message is saved in my archive for thirty days. I've ended the 121 call now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can see on the IMS voicemail console that the recording has moved from Unread to Saved Archive and the tape-reel notification flag has cleared cleanly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the little tape-reel icon at the top of my Samsung screen has just vanished as well.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To stop this ever happening again when you are in a rush, Anusha, I have also enabled a free feature on your S-Net mobile profile called Voicemail-to-Text SMS Alert.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, what does Voicemail-to-Text SMS Alert do? Does it transcribe the audio into a text message?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes! Whenever anyone leaves you a voicemail in the future, our system will automatically send an SMS text message to your Samsung Galaxy S23 with the caller's number and a written transcript of the recording.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, so even if I can't dial 121 straight away, I will still be able to read what the hospital or caller says in a text message?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly right! And I have also switched your mailbox from High-Security Prompt Mode to Home Network Auto-Login so it is much easier when calling from your own handset.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What is the difference between High-Security Prompt Mode and Home Network Auto-Login?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When you dial 121 directly from your own Samsung Galaxy S23 on the S-Net UK network, it will take you straight into your messages without asking for a four-digit code.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is so much better, Megan! I never understood why it asked me for a code when calling from my own biometric-locked phone anyway.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your new four-digit code will still protect your mailbox if you ever dial in from a landline or when roaming abroad, so your medical messages stay completely private.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is the best of both worlds—instant access from my mobile at home in Leicester and still protected from external lines.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also extended the automatic retention period on your Saved Archive folder from thirty days to ninety days so your hospital recordings won't expire automatically.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, ninety days retention is really helpful in case I need to play the appointment instructions back to my husband tonight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And if you ever want to forward a saved voicemail audio clip to your email or save it as an MP3 on your Samsung Galaxy S23, you can also view it inside the S-Net Mobile Visual Voicemail tab.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I didn't know the S-Net app had a Visual Voicemail tab! Let me check if it shows up on my Samsung screen.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have just activated Visual Voicemail provisioning on your line as well, so if you open the S-Net app or the native Samsung Phone app tab, your saved 48-second recording will appear right there.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh wow, I just opened the Voicemail tab in the Samsung Phone app and I can see the 48-second audio bar from 08:46 AM with a play button!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That way you can scrub back and forth through the audio on screen with your finger without even needing to dial 121.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And I just got the confirmation text message from S-Net with my new voicemail settings summary as well. You have been so kind and patient with me this morning, Megan.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It has been my absolute pleasure, Anusha. Just to confirm, is your voicemail box completely unlocked now and have you been able to retrieve and save your hospital clinic message?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my voicemail is completely unlocked, I have got all the details from the cardiology clinic message, and I'm ready to ring Dr Patel's secretary on extension 4419 now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I hope everything goes really well with your echocardiogram appointment at Glenfield Hospital tomorrow morning, Anusha. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Nothing else at all, thank you so much for everything, Megan.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Anusha. Take good care of yourself and have a lovely rest of your day, goodbye!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Megan!
